text:
maria: Draft PRD for Optimize Toolkit is up for review — https://intranet.redwood/prd/optimize-toolkit-draft. TL;DR: customers ask for clear batching/caching/quant recommendations + safe defaults. I sketched three scope slices (MVP = auto-batching + basic prefix cache + 8-bit quant profiles). Need acceptance criteria and launch gating input. @jake @sophia please weigh in.

jake: skimmed it. Couple quick asks: define concrete success metrics (latency p50/p95 targets, per-token cost delta, and quality regressions allowed). Also call out monitoring hooks we need for regressions.

sophia: agree with jake. For quality: we should require <1.5% degradation on the canonical eval set (200 prompts) for generation quality (BLEU/ROUGE + human spot checks). Edge case: long contexts can amplify quant noise; add explicit test for >2k token flows.

lee: implementation notes: KV cache eviction policy and namespace isolation are the hairy bits. Multi-tenant default cache must not leak prefixes across customers. Suggest eviction LRU with TTL and per-customer cache keys. Canary plan: route 5% traffic to cached path, compare token distribution and latency.

anita: from customer success: Large ecom customer wants per-route quant profiles (chat=FP16, embedding=INT8) and an audit log for when we auto-switch quant profiles. This should be a stretch but visible on the PRD.

ops-bot: canary pipeline created for optimize-toolkit/canary-01 (id: can-1971). Logs will stream to #eng-sre.

maria: thanks. Proposed launch criteria (MUST): 1) Auto-batching enabled with observable batching rate, 2) Prefix/KV cache with per-customer isolation + dashboard metrics, 3) Default quant profile (INT8) with fallback to FP16 if quality regressed, 4) Eval pass: canonical eval set regression <1.5%, 5) Canary rollout plan and rollback hooks. (SHOULD): per-route quant override UI, extended audit logs. (COULD): on-prem installer flags for private deploy.

jake: acceptance tests I want added to the PRD: automated harness that runs against stable model + quanted model nightly, emits: p50/p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens, eval quality delta. If quality delta >1.5% or p95 worsens by >20% fail.

sophia: add edge-case tests: 1) long-context (>2048 tokens) coherency suite, 2) non-deterministic sampling stability (5 runs per prompt), 3) adverse tokenization cases (we have a list). These should be runnable in CI with a small fleet.

lee: schedule feasibility: engineering can do MVP + canary in ~6 weeks if we freeze scope to: batching + simple prefix cache + an INT8 quant pipeline + monitoring. Anything beyond per-route UI will push to Q2. Need headcount note in PRD.

anita: adding customer-priority column to PRD: mark per-route quant as "requested by 2 enterprise customers, priority-high". Also include a short user story for audit logs.

maria: updated PRD with those edits. Small config example to include in the spec for ops/devs:
```json
{
  "route": "/chat",
  "batching": {"enabled": true, "max_batch_ms": 8},
  "cache": {"type":"prefix", "ttl_ms":600000},
  "quant_profile": "int8-default",
  "fallback": "fp16-if-regress"
}
```

jake: +1. Also request: add token-level cost metrics in the console (breakdown by model, quant profile, and batch size). That'll make customer tradeoffs visible.

sophia: test harness note: we'll need a curated prompt set (200 cases) including hallucination checks and safety-sensitive prompts. I'll put a PR against infra/testdata.

lee: can tech leads sync tomorrow to firm up scope and resource allocation? If we lock scope today I can work up a sprint plan.

maria: yes — sync 11am tomorrow. Thanks everyone — please leave any final comments on the doc before EOD.
